text.description_html:
PDQ Series 6202CV Narrow Stile Concealed Vertical Panic Device with Electric Latch Retraction

The Narrow Stile Concealed Vertical Panic Device with Electric Latch Retraction is used in commercial and residential settings such as hotels, condominiums, apartment buildings, and government buildings. The Electric Latch Retraction exit device option is designed for entrance and exit doors with panic or fire exit hardware where remote unlocking, remote dogging, access control, or automatic door operator is desired. Activate the momentary latch retraction by using remote push button, card reader, or other devices to allow entrance or exit. The PDQ Series 6200 Concealed Vertical Panic Device with Electric Latch Retraction alway allows free egress to exit.

Features and Specifications of the Concealed Vertical Rod Panic Bar with Motorized Latch Retraction and Dogging:

  • Latch Throw: 5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Bar Projection: 3-1/8" and 2-5/8” projection when dogged.
  • Minimum Stile Width: 2-5/8"
  • Handing: Reversible, non-handed
  • Door Width: 36"
  • Mounting Height: 40" from floor to center line of the bottom latch case mounting stud
  • Rim Cylinder: Schlage C keyway
  • Fasteners: Furnished with sex nuts, machine screws, and wood screws
  • Dogging: Motorized Latch Retraction and Dogging
  • ANSI Grade 1
  • Warranty: 10 Years

    • Special Ordered Item. No Returns
